description: Assign an account (4-8 digits, the user's chart) to whole question groups. For a booking type the answer is remembered for future files of the same client unless remember=false. A revenue account on a group with direction expense (money out) is only usual for refunds or credit notes: ask your user before answering, then pass acknowledge_revenue_on_money_out=true. Without it the answer is applied with a warning in the result (code revenue_on_money_out); an answered question cannot be answered again here, corrections are made in the review on konverter-pro.de.

acknowledge_revenue_on_money_out.description: Your user confirmed a revenue account on money-out bookings (refund, credit note): no warning, remembered on the bookings
